The '''1957 DDR-Oberliga''' was the ninth season of the [[DDR-Oberliga]], the first tier of [[East German football league system|league football]] in [[East Germany]]. Rather than in the traditional autumn-spring format the Oberliga played for six seasons from 1955 to 1960 in the calendar year format, modelled on the system used in the [[Soviet Union]]. From 1961–62 onwards the league returned to its traditional format.

The league was contested by fourteen teams. [[FC Erzgebirge Aue|SC Wismut Karl-Marx-Stadt]], incidentally based at [[Aue, Saxony|Aue]] and not [[Chemnitz|Karl-Marx-Stadt]], won the championship, the club's second consecutive one, having won the 1956 championship as well.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesd/ddrchamp.html |title= East Germany - List of Champions |website= [[RSSSF]] |access-date= 19 January 2016}}</ref><ref name="Meister" >{{cite web |url=https://www.dfb.de/historie/ddr-fussball/meister/ |title= DDR-Meister |website=dfb.de |publisher=[[German Football Association]] |access-date= 19 January 2016|language=de|trans-title= East German champions}}</ref> On the strength of the 1957 title Wismut qualified for the [[1958–59 European Cup]] where the club was knocked out by [[BSC Young Boys|Young Boys Bern]] in the quarter-finals.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/ec/ec195859.html |title=European Competitions 1958-59 |website=[[RSSSF]] |access-date=19 January 2016 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160112171048/http://www.rsssf.com/ec/ec195859.html |archive-date=12 January 2016 }}</ref>

[[Heinz Kaulmann]] of [[ASK Vorwärts Berlin]] was the league's top scorer with 15 goals.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.weltfussball.de/torschuetzenkoenige/gdr-oberliga/ |title= DDDR » Oberliga » Torschützenkönige  |website= Weltfussball.de |access-date= 19 January 2016|language=de|trans-title=DDR-Oberliga top scorers }}</ref>

==Table==
The 1957 season saw two newly promoted clubs, [[FC Carl Zeiss Jena|SC Motor Jena]] and [[Hallescher FC|SC Chemie Halle-Leuna]].<ref name="Ddr" >{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesd/ddrhist.html |title= East Germany 1946-1990 |website= [[RSSSF]] |access-date= 19 January 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.weltfussball.de/spielplan/gdr-oberliga-1957-spieltag/26/ |title= DDR » Oberliga 1957 |website= Weltfussball.de |access-date= 19 January 2016|language=de|trans-title=DDR-Oberliga 1957}}</ref>
